TOOLING BURST T4j — burst_v2 lap 2: expansion + contour dissolve, and one obsolete test removed (Run C-5; Matt 2026-09-16 R-C5-25: "Tab 7 fire burst is far better" — burst_v2 is carried; two conductor-measured defects remain). task_id "T4j".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a (material: erosion + band-step dissolve uniforms), T4e (pieces), T4h INCLUDING its "v2 lap 2 (T4j)" clause — your contract.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py (pieces phase, burst_v2 template fields), export/godot_import.py (piece_burst_v2 emission; the dissolve/erosion driving), export/vfx_material.gdshader (the dissolve band order: currently "hold until 0.5, then remove band 3, 2, 1, 0 at 0.5, 2/3, 5/6, 1"), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/README.md + acceptance.json (your own v2 record), and the conductor's rendered numbers: runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/bake_rows_outside.json (v2 extent 358 → 431 px by frame 15 = 1.20×, largest-component fraction 1.0 through expansion, residue 15.8 % at the origin, release f76) — the two defects: (1) expansion 1.20× against the 1.8× target — your own CPU bound said the rooted-stretch rule caps at ~1.65×; (2) the band-step dissolve removes band 0 (the dark contour) LAST, leaving a black ring around the eroding core (visible at frame 30 of the conductor bake). tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend; and the one removal named below).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import proofs; do not attempt rendered bakes in your sandbox (they SIGABRT there — the conductor bakes outside).

BUILD exactly the T4h lap-2 clause: (a) burst_v2 expansion — each tongue piece's ROOT drifts outward along its radial axis up to `root_drift` (default 0.5 × core radius, ease-out over 0.25 s) while the tongue stretches along its axis by a seeded factor in [2.5, 3.0] (was 1.6–2.0); across-axis 1.0 → 0.7 as before; core wedges as before; keep everything on the effect-age clock and deterministic under seed; (b) dissolve order — add a kit/template field `dissolve_order` (list of band groups in removal order; default [[3],[2],[1],[0]] = legacy so the six kits and burst_v1 export BYTE-IDENTICALLY) and implement it in the shader path (a uniform or a per-band threshold table — choose the smallest change that keeps the legacy behaviour bit-exact) so `fire_burst_e0p_v2` uses [[3],[2],[1,0]] — the contour burns away WITH its fill; (c) REMOVE tests/test_godot_import.py::TouchAimEmissionTests::test_touch_forward_band_and_mouse_probe_precedence (it encodes the retired T4i world-touch aim; T4i-r1 made aim device-based) — nothing else in that file changes.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation of `dissolve_order` (must partition {0,1,2,3}; legacy default); the emitted v2 script contains the root-drift + stretch range; a CPU geometry diagnostic (like your T4h-r1 one) predicting extent ≥ 1.8× at 0.25 s for the T4e-r1 pieces with the new rule while the largest-component fraction stays ≥ 0.9; the six kits + burst_v1 export byte-identical (hash table as before).
ACCEPTANCE (report exact numbers in runs/C-5/t3/T4j/acceptance.json; rendered numbers are the conductor's — mark them UNEVALUABLE in-sandbox): CPU extent prediction ≥ 1.8×; connectivity ≥ 0.9; legacy byte-identity; headless import exit 0; FULL suite outside your sandbox is the conductor's — in-sandbox report every red by name (five standing reds + your env reds; the removed test must no longer appear).

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the three named, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4j/ and runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json (the dissolve_order field). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4j/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4j"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
